failures.root_cause: sw-cleanup.sh dry-run mode does not detect stale heartbeat files or show 'Found N items' summary with '--force' hint
failures.fix: Fix sw-cleanup.sh to scan for stale heartbeat files in dry-run mode and output a summary line showing 'Found N' items with a '--force' hint when items are detected

failures.root_cause: sed invoked without -e flag causing the substitution expression to be treated as a filename
failures.fix: add -e before the sed expression: sed -e "s|$TEST_TEMP_DIR|...|g" instead of passing expression as positional argument
